19 Dead in Nagaland Suspected Spurious Liquor Tragedy; 19 Arrested

Nineteen people have died in Nagaland following the suspected consumption of spurious liquor. The incidents occurred in Mokokchung and Tuensang districts. Nineteen individuals have been arrested in connection with the deaths, and police have launched a probe. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) has been formed to investigate the matter.
